test_title: PYST 76: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 29 Feb, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. No M are N.

II. Some O are N.

**Conclusions:**

I. All O are M.

II. No N is M.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follows

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d6cfd494c5489848418ece0f93863289738d9eefe028583450e412e6afef95c0.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All O are M → Does not follow (As no M are N and some O are N. So it is possible but not definite.)

II. No N is M → Follow (As no M are N. As direct relation is given between M and N that M cannot be N, therefore it is true.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion II follows.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
